heading: Broadway, after curtain call.
opening: The lashes stay on. Somebody at the stage door knows where the party is. dead model takes its cue from the divas who carry a little of the show out into the street.
closing: The ADA sits low and moves with you. Its wax catches the light, the fringe swings with the beat, and the dance floor is yours. You take the stage.
